nota: Guion de las voces de Gemini (scripts/voces.mjs, docs/voces.md). Cambiar una voz, un estilo o un texto regenera solo esas líneas.

cine.estilo: English programming words such as signal, computed, effect, set, update or linkedSignal are said in English

viaje.estilo: English programming words such as signal, computed, effect, set, update or linkedSignal are said in English

colina.estilo: this is an inner thought she says to herself, soft and slow, almost a whisper, with a long pause after 'Así que'

rioplatense.estilo: Rioplatense Spanish accent from Buenos Aires or Montevideo, natural voseo, ll and y pronounced as sh

neutro.estilo: neutral Latin American Spanish, like a dubbed animated film, no strong regional accent

personajes.cap: starship captain in his forties, in command of his crew but shaken by what is happening, firm and clear, short sentences
personajes.naveA: young female starship pilot, emotional and expressive, a little sarcastic with her friends
personajes.naveB: young male starship pilot, curious and nervous, always asking questions
personajes.nave4: young female scout pilot, impatient and full of energy, teasing her slow friends
personajes.angie: calm and wise female guide, gentle, warm and slightly mysterious, never in a hurry, short pauses between ideas

pronunciar.dentro-switchmap: suich map no funciona, tampoco puedo usar los pipes.
